## Analysis

Four materially different searches all returned the same \(n=17\) incumbent or regressed to the seed. This refutes the idea that temperature schedules, tabu memory, crossover, or 3–5-element destruction alone can escape the current basin. The repeated failure across size-changing searches also suggests unstructured coordinates are the wrong representation, not that \(n=17\) is optimal. Progress now requires searching a construction family where a dense core automatically suppresses differences while asymmetric fringes create excess sums.
